subject: Marketplace promotional credit reinstatement request
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@vectorcloud.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@brightsi.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Credits removed mid-POC — urgent reinstatement request

Hi Sean,

Quick one — our POC with Redwood (DEAL-2026-VC-1147) just hit a roadblock: the promotional marketplace credits BrightSI provisioned were revoked this morning without notice. The team is mid-load testing and token usage shows a hard stop. Can you help get those credits reinstated while we sort out how they were applied?

Attached: poc_usage_report.csv (summary of the last 48h usage and error logs).

We need at least a provisional restore for the next 72 hours so the POC team can finish evaluation. Appreciate any fast path you can provide — happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Director of Cloud Partnerships
VectorCloud
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@vectorcloud.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credits removed mid-POC — urgent reinstatement request

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the CSV. Sorry for the interruption. I'm looping in Priyom from Partner Ops and Evelyn from Finance so we can triage rapidly.

Priyom/Evelyn: VectorCloud's POC appears to have had BrightSI-allocated marketplace credits. Alex reports the credits were deallocated this morning (causing the POC to stop). Can we get an immediate provisional reinstatement while we investigate the activation logs?

For speed, please confirm the minimal restore amount (tokens/$) needed to keep the POC running for 72 hours. If we can do a provisional override, let's include a short audit window and a follow-up reconciliation.

If helpful, Alex is available for a quick call today.

- Sean
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@vectorcloud.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@brightsi.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credits removed mid-POC — urgent reinstatement request

Thanks Sean — I pulled the voucher activation logs and have attached the raw activation lines. BrightSI appears to have activated a set of overlapping promo vouchers against the same account; one voucher hit a post-expiry cleanup job that removed the effective credit allocation.

Attachment: voucher-activation-log.txt

Proposal: we can do a provisional reinstatement of up to $5k in credits for 30 days while we complete the partner-ops audit. Conditions: 
- Reinstatement is provisional and will be reconciled after audit.
- Partner (BrightSI) must supply a short remediation note explaining the overlapping activation and steps to prevent recurrence.
- Finance to approve potential reimbursement or chargeback if voucher misuse is found.

Alex — can you confirm $5k covers the remaining test matrix? If not, state the minimal amount and expected time window.

- Priyom
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credits removed mid-POC — urgent reinstatement request

Looping Finance in. Suggested formalization for an exception path: attach the credit-reinstatement-template.docx as the provisional approval form. Finance will authorize a provisional reinstatement (up to $5k) contingent on: 
- Partner remediation note (as Priyom requested).
- DocuSign of the provisional terms by the partner PM.
- Technical verification that the restore is scoped only to the POC account and cannot be re-used elsewhere.

If Legal wants to sign off on the wording, loop them now; otherwise I can approve on a short-cycle basis to avoid blocking the POC.

Attachment: credit-reinstatement-template.docx

Evelyn
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@vectorcloud.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@brightsi.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credits removed mid-POC — urgent reinstatement request

Folks — thank you for the quick turn. Agreement we can proceed with a provisional reinstatement under the Finance conditions. Action items: 
1) Priyom: execute a provisional $5k credit restore scoped to VectorCloud POC account (token pool) and add 30-day expiry. Mark restore as "provisional_reinstate_DEAL-2026-VC-1147".
2) BrightSI (Nina): submit remediation note and sign the provisional terms via DocuSign.
3) Alex: confirm the $5k covers the remaining test matrix; if not, escalate minimal delta today.
4) Evelyn/Laura: reconcile post-audit for potential chargeback.

I'll kick off a brief ops playbook and upload it to the marketplace folder after the provisional restore is live. Please copy me on the DocuSign URL so Finance can track sign-off.

Attachment: provisional-reinstate-terms.pdf (summary of conditions)
